reviews.body:
Reviewed head `5e3fc4522028693c23fd4666afbf24ddb274a2ec`.

The new stop reason is mapped to the existing `model_length` semantics, and the API import boundary now rejects SDK versions older than 0.119.0 with an actionable upgrade message instead of allowing a late streaming validation failure.

Validation completed:
- Version-gate tests cover an older SDK, the 0.119.0 boundary, and newer versions.
- All 54 Anthropic-related tests pass.
- The required CLI smoke test, full pre-commit checks, and all five import contracts pass.
- GitHub unit-tests, perf-tests, and pre-commit pass on this head.

No blocking issue remains in the reviewed scope.
